تضطهدين (form VIII)
# تَضْطَهِدِينَ (taḍṭahidīna) /tadˤ.tˤa.hi.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
# تُضْطَهَدِينَ (tuḍṭahadīna) /tudˤ.tˤa.ha.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِضْطَهَدَ (iḍṭahada)
